scope: Dated teaching snapshots, not live market data or investment recommendations

en.observation: Data Center revenue: $89.0 billion; company-reported quarter, USD.
en.thesis: Compute demand can support durable earnings growth.
en.counter: Segment revenue does not isolate end-user AI returns or prove a fair stock price.
en.flip: Recheck revenue, margins and customer concentration in the next filing; revise if growth depends on weaker cash collection.

zh.observation: 数据中心收入 890 亿美元；公司披露的单季数据，币种 USD。
zh.thesis: 算力需求有望转化为可持续的盈利增长。
zh.counter: 分部收入不能单独证明终端 AI 投资回报，也不能证明股价合理。
zh.flip: 下次财报核对收入、毛利率与客户集中度；若增长伴随回款恶化，则重新审视假设。

en.observation: Microsoft Cloud revenue: $59.3 billion; company-reported quarter, USD.
en.thesis: Cloud usage can monetize AI infrastructure investment.
en.counter: Microsoft Cloud is broader than Azure and AI; this is not standalone AI revenue.
en.flip: Recheck cash flow and capital investment together; revise if monetization does not cover ongoing investment needs.

zh.observation: Microsoft Cloud 收入 593 亿美元；公司披露的单季数据，币种 USD。
zh.thesis: 云服务使用有望变现 AI 基础设施投入。
zh.counter: Microsoft Cloud 范围大于 Azure 和 AI，不能把它全部当成 AI 收入。
zh.flip: 下次同时核对现金流和资本投入；若变现不足以覆盖持续投入，则重新审视假设。
